messages.speaker: nurse
messages.content: Results back: salicylate 7.5 mmol/L, high. VBG shows pH 7.30, PCO2 18, HCO3 12, lactate 4 - mixed picture with a metabolic acidosis. HR 115, RR 30, BP 100/60, sats 97 on room air, GCS 15.

messages.speaker: clinician
messages.content: Let's start a sodium bicarbonate infusion - salicylate's confirmed high at 7.5 with a metabolic acidosis. I want to alkalinize her serum and urine to pull it out of the brain and enhance clearance.

messages.speaker: clinician
messages.content: Send a basic metabolic panel now - I need her potassium and renal function to guide the urinary alkalinization. We can't get the urine pH up without adequate potassium.
